_comment: Hand-written one-liners that survive GitHub sync. Keys are repo names (exact). Prefer these over empty GitHub descriptions and weak README boilerplate.
boplog: Static public build log with llms.txt and a JSON project manifest for agents.
cod: Early scaffold for a coding-related experiment (public placeholder).
_pm: Company issue graph, ledger, ticket scheduler, and benchmarks — published mirror of the Zer0 company OS PM core for automation orchestration.
zer0-cockpit: Read-only, dependency-free terminal project cockpit dashboard for explicit Zer0 project progress.
zer0-harness-spine: Ultra-thin agent harness contracts and provider adapters for the Zer0 agent stack (no orchestration state).
zer0-voice: Voice adapters that bridge the Zer0 harness to machine-wide speech services without vendoring models.
tmux-agent-fleet: Zero-daemon, harness-neutral command palette for coding agents across tmux panes.
portfolio: Personal portfolio site at the intersection of AI, neuroscience, and mobile systems.
ace: Public digital twin demo for Ace Sports: autonomous multi-floor racket sports facility twin with interactive 3D operational model.
tesla-infotainment: Tesla-style web infotainment UI prototype built with Google AI Studio / Gemini.
tesla: Tesla infotainment system experiment in React, TypeScript, and Vite.
claude-island: My work on this fork: multi-profile Claude Code usage monitoring with real-time rate-limit bars, cost/burn-rate tracking, and lifetime savings.
kpu-sim: My work on this fork: GitHub Pages workflow for KPU simulator animations.
coding-interview-university: My work on this fork: optimized learning system with Obsidian canvas.
scrollytelling: Scroll-driven visual story experiment with frame sequences (headphones piece).
Auto-Claude: My work on this fork: OpenAPI remote API, Claude Flow MCP integration, mobile companion, SWE-bench tooling, usage dashboard, and UX/scaling fixes.
jobapp: Job-application factory: cloned target sites, prompts, and portfolio packaging scripts.
cv: LaTeX CV and role-specific resumes (AI/ML, DevOps, PM) with generated PDFs.
evolve: Open-source multi-agent framework for autonomous software development (AI SDLC): agent-swarm orchestration toolkit with Claude Code agents, evidence-based shipping loops, docs, and examples.
blueprint: Product blueprint monorepo: architecture, brand, specs, and a docs website with CI deploy.
z0: Early public scaffold for a Zer0-related experiment (placeholder repo).
whisper: Early public scaffold for a Whisper-related experiment (placeholder repo).
playground: Public sandbox repo for throwaway experiments.
flow: Cross-platform Ratatui TUI for visualizing and controlling multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
monument: AI Studio web app experiment (monument concept UI).
metallic-card: Metallic silver border card UI, synced from v0/Vercel design iterations.
architecture_demo: Architecture portfolio universe: AI-generated visualizations, research, and project docs.
aliens-made-this: Playful generative-art / capability test: what can the aliens make?
AudioEngine: Old iOS project (2017): real-time noise meter and 14-band dual-channel EQ (JubiAudio Phase I wireframe). Last real work ~2017-06-06; 2025 commits were docs cleanup only.
FlowState: My work on this BCI fork: major documentation rebuild plus attention-based video playback speed control.
spy: SPY trading indicator pages published via GitHub Pages.
launch: Launch toolkit: Claude Code / Superdesign commands for parallel UI design generation.
UX: Curated wallpapers and custom macOS icons collection.
hermes-liquid-glass: Linux liquid glass for Hermes Desktop — pywal palette bridge, Hyprland frost opacity, and a runtime plugin that rethemes on wallpaper change.
OpenHands: My commits on this OpenHands fork (experimentation / local patches on the agent platform).
smartvest: iOS Smartshirt / smartvest concept app with Figma-driven mockups.
refind: Personal rEFInd bootloader theme and config.
iOS-2017: My work on this HackIllinois iOS fork: indoor maps view and release cleanup.
